guardLoop: borrow ok; guardian suspends (no new risk + derisk only); borrow refused; repay ok; guardian resumes; borrow ok
stopLoop: publisher stops the worker binding; worker terminates it, adopts afresh, submits and is rejected (StoppedByIntervener); publisher lifts its stop (liftStop); worker submits and is accepted
lifecycle: full stop refused repay; resumed; charter terminated; member ParentNotSatisfied; swarm spec v1 deprecated
setLoop: guardian suspends the presented binding (derisk only) and widens its stop to a full stop through a sibling (superseding document); repay refused although the record shows derisk only; principal terminates the sibling, adopts afresh, self-suspends (derisk only) and presents; repay refused; guardian lifts its stop; repay ok, borrow refused; principal resumes; borrow ok; guardian reopens the first record
